title: serea.action/1 ActionRequest
description: A structured request to cause one action. Owning protocol: Capability Protocol Section 4. This is a security-sensitive closed schema, so undeclared properties are rejected before policy evaluation and before provider execution (Protocol Index Section 4.2 rule 3). risk_class, side_effect_class, required_authorization and provider_id are absent by design: they are host-resolved from the CapabilityDescriptor and are not fields of an ActionRequest at all (Capability Protocol Section 4.2), so a model or any other caller cannot supply them here.

request_id.description: Echoed by the corresponding ActionResult for request/result correlation.

step_id.description: The durable step this request is one attempt of. A genuine second execution carries a distinct step_id and therefore a distinct idempotency_key (Capability Protocol Section 8.2).

capability_version.description: Host-resolved: the caller pins a version and a provider serves any version it declares support for.

arguments.description: Validated against the descriptor's closed input_schema before any authority decision (Capability Protocol Section 3.1). No credential-shaped property is expressible here (Data Classification Section 4).

arguments_digest.description: Host-resolved sha256 over the canonical JSON of arguments (Capability Protocol Section 4.3).

idempotency_key.description: Derived from the request, not the attempt, so every attempt of one step reuses it.

data_class.description: Host-resolved: the highest class of anything in arguments.

requested_by.description: Provenance for audit. It never grants authority: a MODEL-requested write needs exactly the same approval as a USER-requested one.

deadline_ms.description: Host-resolved, never model-supplied. Zero is permitted because Bounds Protocol Section 2.3 makes a bound of 0 meaningful (the dimension is disabled); it is not an invention of this document.

capabilityId.description: Exactly three segments with a verb from the frozen verb set (Protocol Index Section 3; Capability Protocol Section 2).
